title: New Cemetery New Orleans stereo view
blurb: Strereo view of cemetery in New Orleans, entitled "New Cemetery". Notes: Curious title, as it clearly shows one of the older cemeteries in the city. Possibly references that the oldest cemetery in the city, St. Louis Cemetery 1, was at one time the "New" cemetery of the city, replacing an early colonial era cemetery which was decommissioned and built over. View along crypts locally known as "oven" vaults; building seen outside cemetery walls in distance, may be side of building on Conti Street that fronted Basin Street, part of the "Storyville" red light district, Maybe Willie O. Barrera's, or Grace Lloyd's place.
cond: Rectified 2026. Halves registered to 0.11% vertical error and 0.01° of rotation. Depth measured deep (3.12% of frame width); hung in the VR Parlor at full size.
